dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-lateral axis. The most prominent dorsal-mid annulus features a sharp, high-contrast light perimeter with a rapid gradient shift to a darker interior. Posterior to this, an irregular 'C' shape exhibits a feathered, lower-gradient boundary. A third prominent 'O' shape further posterior displays a more diffuse and wider light-to-dark transition zone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid light-intensity pixel clusters concentrated around the anterior flipper region and dorsal midline. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as localized, irregular pixel concentrations against the darker pelage.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three primary dorsal-lateral macro-annuli form an elongated, obtuse triangle. The angle at the central-most centroid is approximately 140 degrees, with the longest leg extending toward the posterior-most identifiable ring structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible, high-contrast light-colored claw structures on the anterior flipper, providing a sharp geometric contrast against the dark limb fur.
